localidad: Nuevo Mundo, Resguardo Indígena Jardín de la Sierra, Orito, Putumayo
comentarios:
This bird was singing at dusk (almost full dark) in some dense saplings in a forest opening in the east Andean foothills of southeastern Colombia. It reminds me of Fulvous Antshrike, and maybe it is that species, but it sounds somewhat more 'tremulous' and not quite a perfect match to another Fulvous Antshrike recorded a couple of km up the same trail. Any ideas are very welcome.
Edit: ID confirmed as Fulvous Antshrike by Diego Calderon and Niels Krabbe
